notes: Source: AV Stumpfl's official "PIXERA one Gen. 2 - Basic technical specifications" PDF (rev. 2024-04-03), cross-checked against the AV Stumpfl/PIXERA "NEXT GENERATION MEDIA SERVER" server manual's rear-panel item descriptions (avstumpfl.com) for exact connector wording. Ports listed above are the fixed/standard chassis I/O only. PIXERA one Gen 2 is a heavily modular real-time media server ("à la carte hardware options") with two SKUs, PX1-2-G2 (Dual) and PX1-4-G2 (Quad) — both have the same 4 physical DisplayPort 1.4a outputs, differing only in how many are software-licensed active. Not included as fixed ports because they are optional plug-in cards and "not all configs possible" simultaneously per AV Stumpfl: video-capture inputs (HDMI 2.0 via PXO-IH2, combined 12G-SDI/3G-SDI + HDMI via PXO-CT1H1, 3G-SDI via PXO-IS1/IS2/IS4 or PXO-CS4/CS8 in/out, 12G-SDI/3G-SDI via PXO-CT4 in/out — all BNC for SDI, HDMI-A for HDMI); an optional GUI output card (2x Mini DisplayPort 1.4a, up to 4096x2160, for local editing/3D visualization monitor); and optional additional audio I/O (SPDIF, AES/EBU, ADAT optical, MIDI) beyond the standard analog stereo TRS output. USB grade (usb-5g) is inferred — AV Stumpfl's spec only says "USB3" without stating generation/speed. Power inlet connector type is inferred as IEC (not explicitly named "IEC C13/C14" in either source). No dedicated video/audio inputs, HDMI, or SDI ports ship standard — this is fundamentally an output/playback media server, with capture being an add-on capability. Case is 1U (44.4mm height), 444 x 441mm footprint, 8.3kg.

ports.name: DisplayPort 1
ports.note: DP1.4a, up to 5120x2880@60Hz; part of the 4 fixed physical outputs (active count is license-gated: Director/2/4)

ports.name: LAN1
ports.note: 10Gbps LAN, fixed IP by default (per serial number label)

ports.name: IPMI LAN
ports.note: dedicated remote-management LAN port; speed not stated in spec

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: single (non-redundant) mains socket, 100-240VAC 50-60Hz, 500W peak; manual calls it 'socket for mains connection' and lists a detachable 'Power Cable' in the box, which is why it's classified as an IEC inlet rather than a captive cord — exact C13/C14 rating not stated
